styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean warm off-white #FAF7F2 studio and lifestyle scenes alternating with deep charcoal #2B2B2B infographic sections

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm home-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm off-white #FAF7F2, deep charcoal #2B2B2B, warm sand #F0E4D4 and one orange accent #FF7A2E; bright soft key lighting with warm glow accents and soft contact shadows, 5500K natural light in lifestyle scenes; modern geometric sans-serif headline type in charcoal #2B2B2B on light grounds and #FFFFFF on dark grounds; consistent rounded info labels; consistent thin-line icon style in a single orange accent; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on and slight 3/4 hero product angles with consistent scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
